This self-contained browser build uses the browser canvas/SVG implementation. The package's Node-only canvas-renderer dependency and upstream build/dev dependencies are not installed or shipped here. No install/build lifecycle scripts were executed. Upstream's most recent push observed during this check was May 2024; this is a stable low-frequency library, not a claim of active maintenance.

Chinese interface, validation, PNG/SVG downloads and page layout are implemented by Lifeisgood, not provided by upstream as a complete Chinese application.
